title: Broken splashes of sunlight spill Across moonlit bows bouncing on currents of dried Creek beds. The mast towering in infancy with sails stretched over
summary: Broken splashes of sunlight spill Across moonlit bows bouncing on currents of dried Creek beds. The mast towering in infancy with sails stretched over Ropes pulling On yesterday #smallpoems #poetryport
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Broken splashes
of sunlight spill
Across
moonlit bows
bouncing on currents
of dried
Creek beds.
The mast towering in infancy
with sails
stretched over
Ropes pulling
On yesterday
#smallpoems
#poetryport
